# Support

## Start with the guides

- [Setup and prerequisites](README.md#setup)
- [Configuration and environments](README.md#configuration-and-environments)
- [Builds and releases](README.md#builds-and-releases)
- [Known limitations](README.md#known-limitations)
- [Contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)

Run commands from the repository root. For dependency or configuration problems, run
`npm run doctor`; for type, lint, formatting, or test failures, run `npm run check`.
After adding a native library, rebuild your development client.

## Open an issue

Use the repository’s **Issues → New issue** chooser:

- **Bug report:** something in the template does not work as documented.
- **Improvement:** a proposed capability or change to a template convention.
- **Documentation:** unclear, incorrect, or missing instructions.

Include a minimal reproduction, the command you ran, your OS, Node/npm versions, and relevant
Expo SDK and device details. Share only sanitized diagnostics. Never attach `.env` files,
signing credentials, access tokens, personal data, or full API responses.

For general framework usage, consult the [Expo documentation](https://docs.expo.dev/) and
[React Native documentation](https://reactnative.dev/docs/getting-started).
Support is provided through repository issues as maintainer availability permits.
